nodes.description: Private address of the contract owner/chef, set to msg.sender in the constructor and receiving tips.
Public mapping from address to Bet struct holding each player's pending wager.
Public array of addresses used as a lookup table of players with pending bets.
Private accumulator of total tips collected by the chef.
Private tip rate in 1/10000 units used to compute the house cut on a winning bet.
Private referral rate in 1/10000 units used to share tips with the bet referrer.
Private cancellation fee rate in 1/10000 units charged when a creator cancels a bet.
Sets _chef to msg.sender and initialises _tipsRate, _cancelFee and _refRate.
Internal view coin toss returning 0 or 1 derived from block.difficulty, block.timestamp, block.gaslimit, block.coinbase and block.number.
Private payout helper that performs raw external calls to the winner, the referrer and the chef.
Private helper that deletes a Bet from Bets and removes the address from BetLUT.
Public payable entry point letting a player place a bet on heads/tails with an optional referrer.
Public payable function refunding a pending bet minus the cancellation fee and then removing the bet.
Public payable function joining an existing bet, resolving the toss and paying the winner.
Public view returning the length of BetLUT.
Public view restricted to the chef returning the accumulated _chefTips.
Chef-only setter updating _tipsRate with a maximum of 1500 (15%).
Chef-only setter updating _refRate with a maximum of 1500 (15%).
Chef-only setter updating _cancelFee with a maximum of 300 (3%).
Caller address controlling bet creation, cancellation, joining and owner-restricted functions.
Block timestamp used as randomness input in toss and stored in the Bet struct.
Transaction origin checked in takeBet as a 'humans only' guard, bypassable via intermediary contracts.
Raw address(to).call{value: amt-tips} transfer inside send, invoked before state cleanup.
Raw address(ref).call{value: refEarn} transfer inside send, paying the referrer share.
Raw address(_chef).call{value: tips} transfer inside send, paying the house.
Unchecked addition win = bet.value + msg.value computed in takeBet.
Unchecked multiplication/division fee = Bets[msg.sender].value * _cancelFee / 10000 in cancelBet.
Address parameter to of send, the payout recipient.
uint256 parameter amt of send, the gross payout amount.
uint256 parameter tips of send, the fee deducted from the payout.
Address parameter ref of send, the referrer receiving a tip share.
Address parameter addr of removeBet, selecting the entry to delete.
uint256 parameter betFor of createBet, the chosen side (0 or 1).
Address parameter ref of createBet, the referrer stored in the Bet.
Address parameter with of takeBet, the bet creator being joined.
uint256 parameter rate of setTipRate assigned to _tipsRate.
uint256 parameter rate of setRefRate assigned to _refRate.
uint256 parameter rate of setCancelRate assigned to _cancelFee.
Memory copy of the Bet struct loaded from Bets[with] in takeBet.
Local tips amount computed from bet.value * _tipsRate / 10000 in takeBet.
Local pot value bet.value + msg.value in takeBet.
Local result of toss() used to select the winner in takeBet.
Local cancellation fee computed in cancelBet.
Loop index used to scan BetLUT in removeBet.
Success flag of the raw call to the payout recipient in send.
Success flag of the raw call to the referrer in send.
Success flag of the raw call to the chef in send.
Referral share amt/2*_refRate/10000 subtracted from tips in send.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the owner _chef in the constructor.
msg.sender is used as the creator key when writing Bets[msg.sender].
msg.sender identifies the bet being cancelled and refunded.
msg.sender is compared with tx.origin and is the potential joiner/winner.
chefTips requires msg.sender == _chef before revealing _chefTips.
setTipRate is gated by require(msg.sender == _chef).
setRefRate is gated by require(msg.sender == _chef).
setCancelRate is gated by require(msg.sender == _chef).
cancelBet passes msg.sender as the payout recipient of send.
takeBet relies on tx.origin == msg.sender, which is spoofable through an intermediary contract.
toss builds its randomness from block.timestamp, making the outcome miner-influenceable.
block.timestamp is written into the Bet.time field and the NewBet event.
block.timestamp is emitted in the WinBet event.
The toss result determines which party wins inside takeBet.
toss() return value is assigned to the local winNum.
takeBet performs the prize payout through send() before removeBet clears state.
cancelBet performs the refund through send() before removeBet clears state.
send executes address(to).call{value: amt-tips} on an attacker-controlled recipient.
send executes address(ref).call{value: refEarn} on an attacker-controlled referrer.
send executes address(_chef).call{value: tips} paying the house.
A malicious recipient can re-enter takeBet while the bet is still recorded in Bets.
A malicious recipient can re-enter cancelBet before removeBet deletes the entry.
takeBet calls removeBet after resolving the bet.
cancelBet calls removeBet after refunding.
removeBet deletes the Bets[addr] entry.
removeBet swaps and pops the entry in BetLUT.
createBet writes the new Bet struct into Bets[msg.sender].
createBet pushes msg.sender onto BetLUT.
takeBet reads the pending bet from Bets[with].
cancelBet reads Bets[msg.sender] value and betFor.
takeBet computes win = bet.value + msg.value without overflow protection.
cancelBet computes value * _cancelFee / 10000 without overflow protection.
The unchecked sum is stored in the local win used as the payout amount.
The unchecked fee computation feeds the local fee charged on cancellation.
_tipsRate scales the tips deducted in takeBet.
_refRate scales the referrer share refEarn in send.
_cancelFee determines the cancellation fee in cancelBet.
_cancelFee is a direct operand of the fee arithmetic operation.
_chef is the destination of the tips external call in send.
send increments _chefTips by the tips amount after the chef call.
chefTips returns the _chefTips accumulator.
setTipRate writes the new value into _tipsRate.
setRefRate writes the new value into _refRate.
setCancelRate writes the new value into _cancelFee.
countBets returns BetLUT.length.
The with parameter indexes Bets to populate the memory bet local.
takeBet loads the Bet struct into the local bet variable.
takeBet computes the local tips from _tipsRate.
takeBet computes the local win pot.
takeBet stores the toss result in the local winNum.
send captures the recipient call result in sentTo.
send captures the referrer call result in sentRef.
send captures the chef call result in sentFee.
send computes the local refEarn referral share.
refEarn is subtracted from tips when the referrer call succeeds.
The loop index i iterates over BetLUT in removeBet.
The addr parameter selects which address is removed from BetLUT.
The to parameter is the recipient of the raw value transfer in send.
The amt parameter is the gross amount transferred in send.
The tips parameter is deducted from amt and routed to referrer and chef.
The ref parameter determines the referrer paid inside send.
betFor is stored in the Bet struct as the chosen side.
ref is stored as the referrer of the new Bet.
rate sets the new _tipsRate value.
rate sets the new _refRate value.
rate sets the new _cancelFee value.
msg.sender is the recipient address of the external refund call in cancelBet's send.

normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter only exists to feed the payout helper send and should be folded into that function node.
amt is a call-local payout amount consumed exclusively by send.
tips is a call-local fee amount consumed exclusively by send.
ref is a call-local referrer address only used by send.
addr is used solely to locate the BetLUT entry in removeBet.
betFor is only used to populate the Bet struct in createBet.
ref is only stored as the Bet referrer in createBet.
with is only used to read Bets[with] and clear the bet in takeBet.
rate is only assigned to _tipsRate inside setTipRate.
rate is only assigned to _refRate inside setRefRate.
rate is only assigned to _cancelFee inside setCancelRate.
The memory copy of the Bet struct is a transient view used only within takeBet.
The tips local is computed and consumed only inside takeBet.
The win local is the payout pot derived from the unchecked sum in takeBet.
winNum holds the toss outcome and drives the branch only in takeBet.
The fee local is computed and consumed only inside cancelBet.
The loop index only exists for the BetLUT scan in removeBet.
The recipient call success flag is only meaningful inside send.
The referrer call success flag is only meaningful inside send.
The chef call success flag is only meaningful inside send.
The referral share local is computed and deducted only inside send.
